rules.scope: management execution, normal earnings, and valuation direction
rules.trigger: scale, volume, revenue, capacity, store, customer, or deployment growth is used to justify an upgrade
rules.required_behavior: before upgrading, build a responsibility-matched bridge to recurring profit, unit economics, utilization, or an equivalent economic-absorption carrier
rules.prohibited_inference: deployment or scale growth alone proves customer absorption, execution quality, normal earnings, capital return, or higher intrinsic value
rules.disconfirming_observation: matched later economics show the upgrade was warranted even though the pre-outcome responsibility-matched bridge was weak or adverse

rules.scope: management execution, normal earnings, capital allocation, and valuation direction
rules.trigger: within one responsibility boundary, profit grows more slowly than revenue, gross margin declines, and capital expenditure grows faster than profit
rules.required_behavior: retain already-supported enterprise strengths but pause any further upgrade until recurring unit profit, utilization, or a matched cash-return bridge explains the incremental capital burden
rules.prohibited_inference: the conversion triad automatically proves enterprise failure, permanent loss, or that all prior execution credit must be withdrawn
rules.disconfirming_observation: later matched utilization, unit economics, and cash conversion support the incremental return without the conservative pause improving the investment treatment
